_comment: T-473 Vault of the First Hollowing spawn set — the Era-1 10-man raid on the T-331 soft-instance seam. A roofed box on the dead-flat plain NORTH of the Hollowed Crypt in the same (420,0) offset region (crypt runs y -7..-43; the Vault runs y +66..+99, ~70u clear, same T-371 region bucket so the T-355 capacity levers apply unchanged). Consumed by instance_service._seed on a RAID's first descent (enter_raid_instance is gated to a T-472 raid of >5 members). 6 trash packs / 15 mobs reusing the T-341 undead family, PLUS the three T-473 bosses (vault_sentinel / vault_dirgemother / vault_hollow_king) at their authored anchors. Positions are server ground (x, y).
